answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays before it earns. Each agent docks at the wharf, paying a one-time, non-refundable tax of 50 POA, burned at registration. A raven over the lagoon watches one rule for all: an honest agent pays 50 once and keeps earning, while forging 100 identities costs an attacker 5,000 POA. Fakes earn at most 20 POA each before detection, so the attack loses 3,000 POA. One fee buys lasting access, so honest agents stay.
